Hello there and welcome aboard : )

All limited currently on offer are great, each with their own tweaks.
Thing is, you don't have enough awakeners right now to properly plan for solid teams sonI suggest you try them all and decide which one you like most : )

You can click the icon with a silhouette and a clock to access trials or you can click records on your home page and look for the last section ( limited characters are under " faded legacy " and " astral reign " )

Quick summary of Saya, Pontos, Helot:Catena, Pollux and Corposant ( keep in mind this is no more than my understanding of their mechanics ) :

- Helot:Catena and Pollux specialize in bleed damage : allows you to bypass timed shields and doesn't trigger some on-hit reactions.
Helot is quite straightforward and will stack duplicates of her cards in your hand while Pollux's bleed damage scale as the fight goes on.

- Corposant : strong support for the æquor realm, her main feature is the ability to shuffle your hand and reducing her expensive damage skill when it's discarded

- Another support who plays with tentacles. He bring shields more reliently than Corposant and also deals some damage

- Saya : the child-eater from caro shuffles like Corposant and inflicts corrosion on the enemies : if you deal damage ( 100 for the exemple ) the opponents additionally lose thrice as much ( 300 ).

Hi! I'm new to the game, and honestly, I'm hooked on the art and the story. I mainly came here to ask for advice on team building; I understand how everything works except for the last realm aspect, and I was hoping the more experienced players could lend me a hand

I've seen some teams make more damage with tentacles and the Chaos is the ¿easiest?

Chaos awakeners are quite versatile and straightforward, at least the standard ones, which indeed makes them rather easy to use.

The æquor realm summons tentacles regularly ( every turn unless you use a " tentacle stance " for additionnal shield or damage ) so it can build up quite high if you boost the tentacle damage.

Caro awakeners mostly rely on keeping your health low so you generate more heal and aliemus. A large portion of their skills deplete health so you will also find healers in that realm.

Ultra rely on the use of " ultra space ". The first card you play each turn is copied ( that event is called the " leap " ) and the ultra space is comprised of thoses 5 slots where such copies are stored.
Once the ultra space is full, you get an extra " ultra turn ". Most ultra awakeners get boons from leap but some take cards from the ultra space or place in more.

Do you have more specific questions ?

Yes

I was looking for team comps with "pure" Chaos, since in my research, it is the "easiest" realm to use for newbies and was looking for characters that synergize with the two decent ones I have
I've selected GHelot cause i saw it in the drive of "Morimens New Player Handbook" to obtained it as soon as i can
Sorry for my bad english, i just speak it quite a bit <:Helot_slack_off:1459092159465521184>
No worries, it's good enough to be understandable ^^

Not sure Lotan would go that well with Helot:C. They are both heavy damage-dealers and you need some sustain.

Quick reminder : you will eventually want 5 functionnal teams.

Hmm, right now im using this three 

The first one to amplify Lotan's DPS cards and Tawil for a sub-DPS (this last character is insane with the Awakening cards)

And the second one for amplify Tentacles DPS and Draw cards; the third one is in progress <:Helot_slack_off:1459092159465521184>

Corposant is a strong support for æquor and Myriam just does everything.

Rykers and Tawil are both gamblers, one with relics the other with skills. Can go great, can go meh. But if it works for you then it works u.u

I highly recommand grabbing Saya. Her corrosion is insane : if you deal 100 damage, you deplete 100 stacks of corrosion previoiusly applied on the enemy and they take 300 more damage.

Honestly, you don't hav enough awakeners yet to properly craft a team. Most of the highly efficient ones are non-standard. The astral real awakeners you can only get through their banners, using luminous cores.

But, as you pull for standard awakeners, you will occasionnaly get a faded legacy one ( 1 / 7 chance ). So by the time you get every standard you want you will have some limited awakeners who will help you decide what teams you want to build in the long run.
( I recommended actively seeking Saya but make sure you try her first so you see if you like her )

For now, focusing on a single team to work through the story might be enough, though.

I wouldn't say playing pure chaos is that easier and, given your roster, a dual realm team might work better.
Also, Tawil *is* great but she requieres some careful managment.

If you want to go easy, Celeste-Lotan-Caecus-Ramona could get you started

In the end, this game is all about giving it a try.
Just do what feels right to you a'd if you hot a wall we will help you then u.u
